en_wahiduddin: But you cannot will it unless God, the Lord of the Universe, so wills it [to show you that way].

en_daryabadi: And ye shall not will unless it be that Allah, the Lord of the worlds, willeth.

en_mubarakpuri: And you cannot will unless that Allah wills -- the Lord of all that exists.

en_shakir: And you do not please except that Allah please, the Lord of the worlds.
